# AI Agent Study Guide

> Documentation repository studying OpenAI Codex-RS TUI architecture for AI coding agents.

## Entry Points

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Complete context (use this for full understanding)

## Documentation

- [docs/architecture-diagram.md](docs/architecture-diagram.md): Mermaid sequence diagrams
- [docs/CONCEPTS.md](docs/CONCEPTS.md): Core concepts
- [docs/GLOSSARY.md](docs/GLOSSARY.md): Term definitions
- [docs/PATTERNS.md](docs/PATTERNS.md): Implementation patterns
- [docs/WORKFLOWS.md](docs/WORKFLOWS.md): Step-by-step task workflows

## Template

- [docs/templates/LLM-OPTIMIZATION-TEMPLATE.md](docs/templates/LLM-OPTIMIZATION-TEMPLATE.md): Reusable template to LLM-optimize any project

## Key Facts

- TUI communicates directly with ThreadManager via channels
- MessageProcessor is ONLY for external JSON-RPC clients
- Op enum: input to agent (UserTurn, ExecApproval, Interrupt)
- EventMsg enum: output from agent (TurnStarted, TurnComplete, AgentMessage)
